description:
## [1.9.0](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.8.1...v1.9.0) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Raid Party:** Raid Party Premium ([c17ee52](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/c17ee52bec52e8755f434d82b65fb03c520663ca))

### ✨ New Features

* **memoryeditor:** Universal live memory editor patch ([a363f4c](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/a363f4c1cfff4937b6a395071a6b5f18a2a1ca51))

patches.name: PairIP bypass (+ OCR scanning)
patches.description: Neutralizes PairIP for Poke Genie end to end: skips the startup program (integrity check + Play-Store paywall) and restores its tables, nukes the Java license/signature checks, stops the native VM (so virtualized methods no-op and nothing re-checks the DEX), and swaps in de-PairIP'd OCR libs so iVision scanning works. Requires a universal arm64-v8a APK. Battle simulator is sacrificed.

patches.name: Unlock All IAPs
patches.description: Forces premium flags and server getters to true/max by short-circuiting their methods.

patches.name: microG-RE support (Google sign-in)
patches.description: Routes Google Play Services to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) and pins Poke Genie's legacy sign-in path so Google sign-in works on the re-signed app. Install MicroG-RE, add your account there. Minimal: no push/FCM.

patches.name: Custom Branding
patches.description: Changes DeFit's app name, header title, and displayed version.

options.description: Text shown in DeFit's top action bar.
Version text shown in the app. Use "auto" to display the patched target version automatically.

patches.name: Login Fix Tutorial
patches.description: Adds an in-app Google Fit login setup guide and a button to copy the installed APK's signing SHA-1.

patches.name: Material You Theme
patches.description: Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived colors and enables safe system Force Dark without changing DeFit's AppCompat theme parent.

patches.name: Remove Bottom Banner Ad
patches.description: Removes DeFit's bottom banner-ad container from the main layout.

patches.name: Session Distance Notification
patches.description: Shows the total distance added during the current sync session in the persistent notification.

patches.name: Unlimited Time Bypass
patches.description: Removes the ad requirement and grants the target DeFit version's maximum active time when the button is pressed.

patches.name: Current Frame Media Artwork
patches.description: Adds an in-player control that updates the media artwork from the current video frame, including while the screen is off. Long press the button to open the settings.

patches.name: Apple emojis everywhere
patches.description: Replaces Instagram's emoji with Apple-style emoji. The emoji font is downloaded once, after asking, the first time the app is opened.

patches.name: Unlock Full Version
patches.description: Unlocks Counter's built-in full-version features, including the Color menu.

patches.name: Live chat reconnect
patches.description: Keeps chats updating live: reconnects the real-time message connection when it drops (e.g. after the app was in the background) and restores the chat's subscriptions.

patches.name: Map post age filter
patches.description: Adds a filter button on the map to only show posts from the past 24 hours, 12 hours, hour or 10 minutes.

patches.name: Material You Theme
patches.description: Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived Material You colors throughout Campfire, with a dark theme that follows the system. Keeps success/warning/danger and game-brand colors.

patches.name: Open game links directly
patches.description: Opens Pokémon GO (and other game) links straight in the game instead of going through the AppsFlyer OneLink redirect page.

patches.name: Skip external link dialog
patches.description: Opens external links right away instead of asking for confirmation first.

patches.name: microG-RE support (Google sign-in)
patches.description: Routes Google Play Services to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) so Google sign-in and push notifications work on the re-signed app. Install MicroG-RE, add your account there and enable Cloud Messaging.

patches.name: Change keyboard name
patches.description: Changes the name shown for Keyboard Designer in Android's keyboard/input-method switcher.

options.description: The name shown by Android when switching input methods.

patches.name: Start with PokeGenie keyboard
patches.description: Adds my PokeGenie-inspired keyboard design on fresh setup and makes it the portrait text-input default.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features, extended design package, and extended keyboard package.

patches.name: Bounty Daily Reward Shortcut
patches.description: Tap Bounty to open Daily Reward; long press it to open Bounty.

patches.name: Daily Reward Background Auto-Claim
patches.description: Checks daily reward eligibility and automatically claims it (bypassing ads) if available. Invoke by sending intent as broadcast, with action app.danielthemaniel.pokeraid.CHECK_DAILY_REWARD, and package me.pokeraid.

patches.name: Disable Ads
patches.description: Disables ads locally using PokeRaid's built-in Disabled ad strategy.

patches.name: Disable Analytics
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, and Advertising ID collection while preserving app functionality.

patches.name: Hide News Banners
patches.description: Hides PokeRaid announcement carousels without breaking Data Binding.

patches.name: Material You Theme
patches.description: Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived Material You colors throughout PokeRaid while preserving semantic status and raid-type colors.

patches.name: Quick Join Button
patches.description: Adds an optimistic JOIN button to room cards using PokeRaid's stock authenticated join request.

patches.name: Client-Side Premium
patches.description: Removes ads, the join wait, and premium UI locks by forcing the local premium flag. Server features (boss-subscription notifications, premium visible to others) are unaffected.

patches.name: Google Login Fix (microG-RE)
patches.description: Fixes "Authentication Failed" after re-signing by routing Google Play Services to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms), which presents Raid Party's original signing certificate so Google issues a valid ID token. Install MicroG-RE and add your Google account there. Login only; no Facebook, no push/FCM.
